title: One quarter, re-scored
summary: The page's one paper moment: a page of the Rebuild Sequence as it leaves the quarterly review — last quarter's ranked plan beside this quarter's across the full width, ink lines joining each item's ranks, states in words, one red climb with the reason beside it; the asset line and the reading sit in one row under the sheet.
story: Answers “what changes each quarter?” with the document the cadence above produces: a plan re-scored, where one thing shipped, one was cut for no lift, one is new, and the committee one-pager climbs to first because win/loss named security review as the stall — the loop visibly feeding Narrative. The reading says why the re-score matters.
